label: Official source
description: First-party website or channel belonging to the named organization/institution.

label: Recognized educational source
description: Established educational, research or community organization with a clear identity and track record.

label: Scholar-linked
description: Resource has a clearly identifiable scholar or scholarly institution associated with it.

label: Community source
description: Useful community-created material with identifiable provenance, but not first-party.

label: Source not yet assessed
description: Candidate resource discovered by search but provenance has not yet been established.
